research_object: Single-photon identity and symmetry-transformed quantum states
validated_constraints: Do not introduce a distinct antiphoton under the standard-model scope.
A global charge-conjugation phase is not by itself an observable state distinction.
Helicity, direction, polarization, and OAM must not be relabeled as new particle species.
Time reversal requires an explicit antiunitary convention.
recommended_reframing: Which photonic transformations produce an operationally distinguishable state, and which merely encode self-conjugacy or a convention-dependent label?
